results.name: installed-parity
command:
import importlib.util, pathlib, tomllib, hashlib, sys
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); config=tomllib.loads((root/'source/pyproject.toml').read_text()); count=0
for package, relative in config['tool']['setuptools']['package-dir'].items():
    spec=importlib.util.find_spec(package)
    assert spec and spec.origin,package
    installed=pathlib.Path(spec.origin).parent
    for source in sorted((root/'source'/relative).iterdir()):
        if source.is_file() and (source.suffix in ('.py','.json') or source.name=='py.typed'):
            target=installed/source.name
            assert source.read_bytes()==target.read_bytes(),(source,target)
            count+=1
print('Installed product/schema parity:',count,'files')
